name: Don't Hang Up
source:
You and your friend just had a heated argument, as you're walking home you get a call, and it's FROM THEM?! You feel like should hang up!

[From [url=https://briarfaye.itch.io/dont-hang-up]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和你的朋友刚刚发生了激烈的争吵，当你步行回家时接到电话，是他们打来的？！你觉得应该挂掉！

[来自[url=https://briarfaye.itch.io/dont-hang-up]Itch.io[/url]]
